def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # horizontal separator?
    rsep=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and len({v for r in g for v in r})>1]
    csep=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    # pick separator: full line of one color that's not part of noise regions
    sep_row=None; sep_col=None
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and sum(r.count(g[i][0]) for r in g)==h: sep_row=i
    for j in range(w):
        if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and sum(r.count(g[i][j]) for r in g)==h: sep_col=j
    from collections import Counter
    if sep_row is not None:
        top=[r[:w] for r in g[:sep_row]]; bot=[r[:w] for r in g[sep_row+1:]]
        H,W=len(top),w
        A,B=top,bot
        cellsA=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)]
        def ga(i,j): return A[i][j] if i<len(A) else None
        def gb(i,j): return B[i][j] if i<len(B) else None
    else:
        A=[r[:sep_col] for r in g]; B=[r[sep_col+1:] for r in g]
        H,W=h,len(A[0])
        def ga(i,j): return A[i][j]
        def gb(i,j): return B[i][j]
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    # shared color: appears in both regions
    ca={v for r in A for v in r}; cb={v for r in B for v in r}
    shared=list(ca&cb)[0]
    out=[[3 if ga(i,j)==gb(i,j) else shared for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    sep_row=next((i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and cnt[g[i][0]]==w), None)

    if sep_row is not None:
        A=[list(r) for r in g[:sep_row]]; B=[list(r) for r in g[sep_row+1:]]
        H,W=len(A),w
        ga=lambda i,j: A[i][j] if i<len(A) else None
        gb=lambda i,j: B[i][j] if i<len(B) else None
    else:

    ca={v for r in A for v in r}; cb={v for r in B for v in r}
